summary: Escorted courier access and consolidated asset handoff for departing contractor's peripherals and encrypted SSD
description:
Issue summary:
Departing contractor (Elena M.) completed last working day and left several peripherals in her hotdesk locker at Canary Wharf site. Assets include 2x monitor stands, 1x USB-C dock, 2x power bricks (one proprietary), and 1x company-encrypted NVMe in an external enclosure intended for return to IT.

Impact:
- Items must be retrieved and inventoried for redistribution and warranty tracking.
- Courier attempted pickup on 2026-03-09 but building security denied handoff because contractor badge expired and no escort was present.
- Delay risks loss of warranty window for one monitor and delays in preparing replacement for incoming hire.

Location:
- Canary Wharf office, Locker Bay B3, Level 2 (near team kitchen).

Steps already taken:
1) Reporter emailed Facilities and Security (ticket created).
2) Courier (QuickShip Ref QSH-77823) made a failed pickup attempt and left photo evidence with security.
3) Security requested an approved escort and an asset inventory sign-off before releasing any company hardware to a third-party.

Requested outcome:
- Schedule an escorted handoff window with Security and QuickShip for 2026-03-13 between 10:00-12:00.
- Provide temporary escorted access (escort badge) for courier and a Facilities rep to unlock locker B3.
- IT (Asset Management) to decommission the encrypted NVMe and generate return paperwork (RMA/log entry).

Attachments:
- Photo of locker contents and security pickup note: s3://redwood-assets/internal/INT-522401/locker-B3-20260309.jpg
- Courier confirmation screenshot: s3://redwood-assets/internal/INT-522401/courier-qsh-77823.png

Notes: please follow the escorted courier runbook and ensure two-person verification when handing over the encrypted NVMe.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:18 - Omar Patel (Facilities): Acknowledge. Reaching out to Security to confirm available escort slots. Tentatively proposing 2026-03-13 10:30. Adding Asset Management to thread.

2026-03-10 11:02 - Helen Chen (Security): Confirmed we can provide an escorted window 2026-03-13 10:00-11:00. We require courier ID, vehicle reg, and a pre-filled asset handover form. Security will not release encrypted storage without IT approval on-site.
2026-03-10 15:45 - Jacob Meyer (QuickShip courier QSH-77823): Pickup rescheduled to 2026-03-13 10:15. Vehicle reg AB12XYZ. Driver ID provided: J.Meyer. Awaiting escort details and asset form.

2026-03-11 08:56 - Priya Singh (IT Asset Management): Will attend handoff to verify serial numbers and wipe schedule. NVMe serial SN-09X4 will be placed on hold in inventory. Preparing asset-return form (ref ARF-2026-522401).
2026-03-12 17:20 - Omar Patel (Facilities): Finalizing escort assignment: Security officer David M. and Facilities lead on-site. Confirmed locker B3 access code reset and temporary tag applied.
2026-03-12 17:22 - Lena Ortiz (Reporter): Thanks — please confirm if the proprietary power brick requires special packaging for courier insurance (monitor warranty claim).
investigation: Initial triage: Security logs show courier arrival at 2026-03-09 14:07 and refusal due to expired badge. Photos verify items and indicate serials are legible. Asset Management checked internal inventory: monitor serials not currently under warranty claims but one unit is within vendor 30-day registration window. Hypothesis: pickup failure was procedural (missing escort + form), not due to asset disposition disagreement. Next steps: schedule escort, validate form, and perform two-person verification for encrypted NVMe before release.
resolution: Planned: Escorted handoff scheduled for 2026-03-13 at 10:15. Security to provide escort officer David M.; Facilities (Omar) will be on-site to unlock locker and confirm packaging. IT (Priya) will verify NVMe serial and initiate secure wipe or transfer to secure transit case. Courier QuickShip to present ID and vehicle reg AB12XYZ. Follow-ups: create ARF-2026-522401 in Asset Management, confirm warranty transfer/registration for monitor within 3 business days, update inventory tags. Ticket will be closed after inventory confirmation and upload of signed handover form to Confluence.
